relations.statement: isSpacelike P x y iff isSpacelike P y x for a finite strict poset P
relations.hypotheses: P : FiniteStrictPoset n, x y : Fin n

relations.statement: No point is spacelike to itself
relations.hypotheses: P : FiniteStrictPoset n, x : Fin n

near_misses.claim: The finite spacelike relation of CausalOrder yields commutation of local algebras A(O1), A(O2) for spacelike regions of a continuum net
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The repository has no continuum net over regions and no Minkowski light cone; the finite poset only gives a combinatorial relation, so locality of a continuum net is not derivable from it

near_misses.claim: Spacelike separation is transitive on finite strict posets
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Refuted by the N-poset counterexample in CausalOrder: spacelike(0,1) and spacelike(0,3) hold while 1 is below 3
